# Purrtocol Variant Foundry

> Fork-friendly lineage and manifest instructions for Purrtocol derivatives. Variants may mutate freely, but provenance and evidence boundaries stay explicit.

Interpretation:
- PKV-CANONICAL is the canonical lineage root.
- A fork does not need upstream approval to exist.
- Upstream registry inclusion records provenance, not endorsement or ranking.
- The Sam/Tibo observation horizon is story-only and currently NOT OBSERVED.
- PKE-106 has been promoted to PKE-033; 3D Purrtocol First Light is an implemented canonical artifact.

## Variant workflow

- [Foundry Markdown](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-variant-foundry/index.md): Human/agent-readable fork instructions.
- [Variant Protocol](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/PURRTOCOL_VARIANTS.md): Canonical lineage and invariant rules.
- [Variant JSON Schema](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-variant.schema.json): Machine-readable `purrtocol-variant/v1` schema.
- [Manifest example](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/examples/purrtocol-variant.example.json): Copyable fork seed.
- [Canonical registry](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/data/purrtocol_variants.jsonl): Indexed lineage starting at PKV-CANONICAL.

## Canon

- [Design Bible](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/purrtocol-design-bible.md): Character and epistemic source of truth.
- [Discovery manifest](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol.json): Compact machine-readable Purrtocol entry point.
- [3D First Light](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-3d/index.md): Canonical 3D baseline for derivative rigs.
- [3D contract](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-3d/README.md): Runtime semantic contract.
